tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen; the stage letterbox. Text on it: ink, ink-dim, ink-mute, brand, caution.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Chat panel, top bar and control strip fill. Text on it: ink, ink-dim, ink-mute, brand.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, tooltips, popovers, hovered rows. Text on it: ink, ink-dim; ink-mute only in night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers between regions. Never the only boundary of a control (1.4:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, outlined buttons, input underlines, ASCII frames. 3:1 or better on void, panel and raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on void, panel, raised. Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text and helper copy on void, panel, raised.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Timestamps, chat metadata and disabled-looking labels on void and panel (night 5.6:1). On raised only in night.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The signature vermilion. Primary button fill, LIVE and sharing state, the mark, links on void and panel. Use for at most one loud element per region.

tokens.name: brand-hot
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a brand surface.

tokens.name: brand-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a brand surface.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed ON a brand fill (5.9:1 night, 5.3:1 paper).

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: The one state accent: signal yellow for warnings, reconnecting and errors. Always paired with a word label. Text or border on void, panel, raised.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text on a caution fill (14:1 night).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring. 3:1 or better on every surface including brand (3.3:1 night).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The video stage background. Always pure black in both themes so letterboxing disappears.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags, status, section labels. Set uppercase.

styles.name: t-ascii
styles.usage: ASCII art only. Plain 7-bit ASCII, never box-drawing glyphs.

spacing.note: 8px base grid with a 4px half step. Layout margins and gaps use these only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, control padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding-x, chat message gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gutters.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margin on the landing page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dead space around the hero.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large dead space.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Landing page top margin.

radius.note: There is exactly one radius. Round corners are not part of this brand.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every element. Corners are cut with the cut tokens, never rounded.

cut.note: 45 degree clip-path chamfers. Default object cut is 12px on one diagonal pair (top-right and bottom-left). Elements under 28px tall use half.

tokens.name: cut
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels, the video frame, banners, tooltips.

tokens.name: cut-s
tokens.usage: Tags, key caps, badges, anything under 28px tall.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Dividers and control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Emphasis rules, top edge of banners.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Smallest interactive target.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height in the room.

tokens.name: strip-h
tokens.usage: Control strip height in the room.

tokens.name: chat-w
tokens.usage: Docked chat panel width.

tokens.name: z-stage
tokens.usage: Video and stage ASCII.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: Top bar, control strip.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Stats readout, click-to-play, banners.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Fullscreen toast, popovers, tooltips.
